xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4696: Verify automatic Fly reap and heartbeat on the deployed build (PAN-4295 follow-up)

plan.title: Verify automatic Fly reap and heartbeat on the deployed build (PAN-4295 follow-up)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4295 restored automatic Fly reap and the ephemeral-VM host heartbeat, but its pre-merge smoke test could only drive the reap manually from the feature branch's own dist/ build. The automatic 60 s deacon-lite hand-off, the 'remote-reap' journal source and a fresh /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat can only be observed on the deployed deacon child, which now runs buildCommit 6563a676 containing PAN-4295, PAN-4682, PAN-4683 and PAN-4748.
narratives.Proposal: Run one throwaway Fly smoke issue through the deployed, un-worked-around path (pan plan SMOKE --auto, then pan start SMOKE --remote), observe the three behaviors with exact commands (two heartbeat stats >=60 s apart, the '[deacon-lite] Remote reap SMOKE: handed-off' line in ~/.overdeck/logs/dashboard.log with no operator reap, review.requested source remote-reap in the materialized workspace journal), clean up the run, and record each result as a row under a new '### Post-deploy verification (PAN-4696)' heading in docs/fly-provider.md. Failed checks are root-caused and filed, never fixed in this branch.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No source code changes under src/ in this branch; a failed check is filed as a new issue (D-3)
- No pan reload, pan restart, pan up, or deacon restart from the workspace
- No pan admin remote reap (including --dry-run) for the smoke issue before the automatic hand-off is observed or the 10-minute timeout expires
- No deep-wipe or other destructive HTTP request, and no manual rm of the smoke workspace
- No verification of the credential refresh loop, the VM watchdog self-stop, Fly machines (PAN-4652) or Codex on Fly (PAN-4296)
- No unfreezing of the deacon and no --force on pan start
- No [remote.fly] image override, manual branch push or --plan skip unless a PAN-4682/PAN-4683 regression is filed first (D-5)

autoDecisions.summary: The issue itself is the operator's consent for Fly spend and the temporary remote.enabled=true flip; no AskUserQuestion checkpoint.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4295's D-7 asked consent because its smoke was a side task; this issue exists solely to run that smoke, and auto mode forbids questions. The flip is restored in smoke-cleanup even on failure.

autoDecisions.summary: Drop the issue body's setup workarounds ([remote.fly] image override, manual push + --plan skip).
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4682 (a7fdf79133e) and PAN-4683 (babf86c1b92) are merged and are ancestors of the deployed buildCommit 6563a676, and the issue scoped those workarounds 'until #4682/#4683 is fixed'. Running the plain path doubles as their live regression check; the workarounds stay as the D-5 fallback.

autoDecisions.summary: Start with pan plan SMOKE --auto then pan start SMOKE --remote, not pan start SMOKE --remote --plan auto.
autoDecisions.rationale: The post-planning auto-start goes through the dashboard spawn route's guardrail gate, which was refusing hand-offs on this host at 11/10 work agents; the direct CLI remote start does not pass that gate, so the run is deterministic.

autoDecisions.summary: A failed check is root-caused and filed as a new issue; no code fix lands in this branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: A fix here could not be observed live until another merge and Flywheel deploy, so it would need its own post-deploy check; the issue's deliverable is the verified record.

autoDecisions.summary: The smoke task includes two 'sleep 75' steps.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4677's agent lived about 80 s, leaving room for one heartbeat write at most; FR-3 needs two readings at least 60 s apart while the agent is WORKING. Two 75 s sleeps stay under Claude Code's 120 s Bash default timeout.

autoDecisions.summary: Hand-off timeout is 10 minutes (10 deacon-lite ticks) after REMOTE_DONE; only then may the manual reap run, for cleanup.
autoDecisions.rationale: Allows for one transient reap failure such as PAN-4677's 'cannot lock ref' while keeping the machine from billing indefinitely.

metadata.sizeJustification: Single operational run; every item touches docs/fly-provider.md and one live Fly machine, so items are intrinsically sequential.

items.title: Re-check the deployed build and loop preconditions before the smoke run

verify_commands: sqlite3 -readonly ~/.overdeck/panopticon.db "select value from app_settings where key='deacon.globally_paused'"
expected_outputs: grep prints one line number for the new heading
health JSON shows a buildCommit that has 74f4da1fb85, a7fdf79133e, babf86c1b92 and 4d5461bfccd as ancestors

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4696.md). Run every command in the PRD 'Verified preconditions' table: buildCommit from curl -s localhost:3011/api/health; git merge-base --is-ancestor for 74f4da1fb85 (PAN-4295), a7fdf79133e (PAN-4682), babf86c1b92 (PAN-4683), 4d5461bfccd (PAN-4748) against it; deacon status (GET /api/deacon/status, pid + deaconLite.intervalMs 60000); freeze flag in ~/.overdeck/panopticon.db app_settings key deacon.globally_paused; /home/eltmon/.fly/bin on the deacon child's PATH (/proc/<pid>/environ); fly auth whoami; fly machines list -a pan-workspaces --json (note but never touch pre-existing machines). If a fix commit is not deployed or the freeze is true: pan tell flywheel-orchestrator with the reason, record it in continue.json, and stop — never pan reload/restart, never unfreeze. Otherwise add the '### Post-deploy verification (PAN-4696)' heading and the preconditions paragraph (PRD WI-1 step 5 text) to docs/fly-provider.md after the PAN-4295 '## Live verification' paragraph and before '## Live verification (PAN-4652)'. Raw output goes to .tmp/pan-4696-evidence.md (gitignored). Commit with trailer 'Item: preflight-deployed-build'.

items.title: Given the deployed dashboard, when the agent runs the four git merge-base --is-ancestor checks against the health buildCommit, then each exits 0 and the commit hashes appear in the new docs paragraph

Given the deacon freeze flag reads true or a fix commit is missing, when the precondition check runs, then the agent emits a pan tell to flywheel-orchestrator and stops without running pan reload, pan restart or any unfreeze

docs/fly-provider.md renders a '### Post-deploy verification (PAN-4696)' heading located after the PAN-4295 Live verification paragraph and before '## Live verification (PAN-4652)', naming the build commit and deacon pid
Launch the throwaway smoke issue on Fly through pan plan --auto then pan start --remote

verify_commands: gh issue list --repo eltmon/overdeck --search 'Fly remote smoke test (PAN-4696)' --state all
expected_outputs: the smoke machine named in remote-state.json vmName is listed as started

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Flip 'enabled = false' to 'enabled = true' under [remote] in ~/.overdeck/config.toml (touch nothing else). Create the smoke issue with the exact title 'Fly remote smoke test (PAN-4696)' and the PRD WI-2 body (one-line append to docs/fly-smoke.txt, then two 'sleep 75' steps, then commit and push; marked throwaway, do not merge). Run 'pan plan SMOKE --auto' and wait (single foreground loop, print on change, cap 30 min) until it is Planned; then run 'pan start SMOKE --remote' with no --plan and no --model (decision D-2). On guardrail or spend-cap refusal wait for headroom (poll every 5 min, cap 60 min), never --force; after the cap tell the flywheel and stop. If a second planning session starts or the image is missing, apply D-5: file a regression issue linking PAN-4683/PAN-4682, then use the old workaround (push feature branch + --plan skip, or [remote.fly] image override). Wait (cap 20 min) for ~/.overdeck/agents/agent-<smoke>/remote-state.json status running; record vmName, tier (must be ephemeral), machine id (fly machines list entry whose name equals vmName) and image. Append the launch sentence to the PAN-4696 subsection and commit with 'Item: smoke-launch-remote'.

items.title: Given remote.enabled flipped to true, when the agent runs pan plan SMOKE --auto then pan start SMOKE --remote, then remote-state.json reports status running with tier ephemeral and no second planning-<smoke> session is created

The PAN-4696 subsection in docs/fly-provider.md contains the smoke issue link, machine id, vmName, ephemeral tier and image, and records that no --plan skip, image override or manual push was used — or contains the link to the filed D-5 regression issue
Given a guardrail or spend-cap refusal, when pan start is retried, then the agent never passes --force and falls back to pan tell flywheel-orchestrator after 60 minutes
Prove the hygiene heartbeat keeps /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat under 2 minutes old while the smoke agent works

expected_outputs: grep prints the heartbeat table row

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Within 2 min of status running, take reading 1 with: fly ssh console -a pan-workspaces --machine <id> -C "sh -c 'date -u +%s; stat -c %Y /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat; stat -c %y /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat; test -f /workspace/.pan/REMOTE_DONE && echo DONE || echo WORKING'" (fallback: fly machine exec <id> "<cmd>" -a pan-workspaces). Take reading 2 at least 60 s later. Pass: both ages (now - mtime) under 120 s, both WORKING, reading 2 mtime strictly later than reading 1; corroborate with a 'Host heartbeat refreshed for SMOKE on <vmName>' line in ~/.overdeck/logs/dashboard.log. Failure => decision D-3 (root-cause, file an issue linking PAN-4295 and PAN-4696, record honestly, pan tell flywheel-orchestrator; no code fix in this branch). Add the '| Check | Result |' table and the 'Heartbeat (FR-3)' row to the subsection; commit with 'Item: heartbeat-check'.

items.title: Given the smoke agent is WORKING, when the agent stats /workspace/.pan/host-heartbeat twice at least 60 s apart, then both readings are under 120 s old and the second mtime is later than the first
The 'Heartbeat (FR-3)' table row in docs/fly-provider.md shows both ISO mtimes, their ages in seconds and the gap between readings, or links the filed D-3 issue on failure
dashboard.log contains at least one 'Host heartbeat refreshed for <SMOKE> on <vmName>' line quoted in the evidence file
Prove the deployed deacon-lite tick hands the finished smoke agent off with no operator reap

expected_outputs: grep prints the reap table row
a '[deacon-lite] Remote reap <SMOKE>: handed-off' line is printed

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. One foreground poll loop (every 20 s, print only on change with date -u; cap 30 min after running, then 10 min after REMOTE_DONE) watching: REMOTE_DONE on the VM (record its mtime), 'Remote reap SMOKE' in ~/.overdeck/logs/dashboard.log, and whether vmName is still in fly machines list -a pan-workspaces --json. Never run pan admin remote reap (even --dry-run) before the hand-off line appears or the 10-min timeout expires (NFR-3). Pass: '[deacon-lite] Remote reap SMOKE: handed-off (...)' within 600 s of REMOTE_DONE, machine gone, workspaces/feature-<smoke>/ exists. A failed first attempt followed by a later-tick hand-off still passes. Record whether details include 'Requested review through the dashboard review route' and how many .jsonl files ~/.overdeck/agents/agent-<smoke>/remote-sessions/ holds (D-8, informational). On timeout apply D-4 (check freeze + log, record failure per D-3, then run the manual reap once for cleanup only). Add the 'Automatic reap (FR-1)' row and commit with 'Item: auto-reap-check'.

items.title: Given REMOTE_DONE exists on the VM and no operator reap command has run, when deacon-lite ticks, then dashboard.log emits '[deacon-lite] Remote reap <SMOKE>: handed-off' within 600 seconds
After the hand-off, fly machines list -a pan-workspaces no longer returns the smoke machine and workspaces/feature-<smoke>/ exists on the host

The 'Automatic reap (FR-1)' row in docs/fly-provider.md contains the quoted handed-off details line, the REMOTE_DONE time, the seconds to hand-off and the remote-sessions JSONL count, or contains the filed D-3 issue link on timeout
Confirm the hand-off journals review.requested with source remote-reap

expected_outputs: a review.requested line containing "source":"remote-reap" is printed
grep prints the journal table row

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Read workspaces/feature-<smoke>/.overdeck/pipeline.jsonl. Pass when a review.requested entry has "source":"remote-reap". If it says "api", or no review.requested entry exists (check the reap details for 'Review not requested (<reason>)'), apply D-3. Add the 'Journal source (FR-2)' row quoting the real journal line trimmed to type/issueId/source/ts; commit with 'Item: journal-source-check'.

items.title: Given the automatic hand-off requested review, when the agent greps the materialized workspace's .overdeck/pipeline.jsonl, then a review.requested entry returns source remote-reap
The 'Journal source (FR-2)' row in docs/fly-provider.md quotes the journal line with "source":"remote-reap", or links the filed D-3 issue when the source is api or the entry is missing
Stop the smoke review, close its PR and issue, and restore remote.enabled=false

expected_outputs: no machine named after the smoke issue is listed

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7, run right after journal-source-check so the review convoy stops billing (D-9). pan review abort SMOKE; pan kill SMOKE if a session is still listed. gh pr close <smoke PR> --repo eltmon/overdeck --delete-branch with a throwaway comment; gh issue close SMOKE with a comment. Restore 'enabled = false' under [remote] in ~/.overdeck/config.toml and remove any [remote.fly] image line D-5 added. Confirm no smoke machine remains. Leave workspaces/feature-<smoke>/ for the close-out reaper: no manual rm, no deep-wipe. Append the cleanup sentence under the table; commit with 'Item: smoke-cleanup'.

items.title: Given the journal evidence is captured, when cleanup runs, then gh pr view on the smoke PR returns state CLOSED with mergedAt null and its branch is deleted
gh issue view SMOKE returns CLOSED and ~/.overdeck/config.toml shows enabled = false under [remote] with no [remote.fly] image line left from the run
fly machines list -a pan-workspaces returns no smoke machine, and no deep-wipe request or manual rm of workspaces/feature-<smoke> is issued
Point the PAN-4295 deferral sentence at the PAN-4696 result and refresh the codebase-map Fly bullet

verify_commands: grep -c 'are checked after deploy in' docs/fly-provider.md

In docs/fly-provider.md replace the three-line PAN-4295 sentence 'The automatic 60 s tick, the `remote-reap` journal source and the heartbeat / file are checked after deploy in / [#4696](...).'
